description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternal` that extends `HTMLPurifier_URIFilter`. It provides functionality to filter URLs, possibly to disable external links based on host comparison.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternal
classes.description: A URI filter class used to disable external URLs based on host matching, used within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter by obtaining the host part of the current host to compare against URLs. Stores the reversed host parts for later comparison.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines if a given URI should be allowed based on whether it shares the same host as the current host, or is null, effectively disabling external links.
